rules.subject: Additional fifth and version support
rules.answer: 可以的，追加第五是伙伴效果所给予的追加技能，授权
rules.meaning: Both fifths selectable independently with either soul; authorize minimal public version support.
Entry reflect; shield and barrier count in comparison/maxHP; unused conversion expires at first-round end. Effective HP/maxHP include shield/barrier, healing only fills actual HP.
Actual healing drives percent damage; only healing beyond maxHP becomes shield, not healing prevented/reduced.
Fallback only after acting last and failing to apply bind.
Choice consumes even when controlled; all own skill opponent-stage conditions use negative view of positive stages; underlying stages not rewritten merely by view.
